tools.name: preflight_change_set
tools.description: Use this when: a contract artifact (OpenAPI, GraphQL, protobuf, AsyncAPI, MCP manifests, or agent tool schemas) changes before merge, deploy, publish, or tool registration; AND any agent-executed operation with no supported contract type — send type agent_operation. Do not call for documentation-onl

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description:
Verify a CodeRifts signed chain-receipt you ALREADY HOLD: cryptographic
authenticity (signature + key id), body binding, and — when lifecycle indices
are available — whether it is currently valid authorization (not expired,
superseded, or revoked) for a stated operation/target.

Use this when:
- You

tools.name: get_decision_details
tools.description:
Retrieve a PAST CodeRifts decision by exactly one identifier
(case_id | decision_id | fingerprint): full report, breaking changes, scores,
and linked receipt metadata if stored.

Use this when:
- You have a decision_id (or fingerprint) from a previous preflight, PR
  comment, or CI log and need to i

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_receipt" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify_receipt" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: token, operation, target_id, environment, fingerprint, audience, repository, branch, pull_request, base, head, decision_result

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_decision_details · Private data: preflight_change_set, verify_receipt, get_decision_details · Public sink: preflight_change_set · Destructive: get_decision_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_decision_details · Private data: preflight_change_set, verify_receipt, get_decision_details · Public sink: preflight_change_set · Destructive: get_decision_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
